newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Eight stocks rose, five fell and six were flat in 25.5-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Monday with the WIG 20 index closing at 1,669.1 points, 0.6 percent higher than at the regular session.
Of the four remaining stocks three did not trade and WBK was suspended after Allied Irish Banks' (AIB) Friday call of a public tender offer at 14 zlotys.
NFI units fell 0.7 percent in an 8.5-million-zloty turnover.
